name: Alternating Lateral Ball Slams
instructions: Set up for the Alternating Lateral Ball Slams with an implement. Get into position with your core braced.
Perform the movement slowly, breathing steadily — exhale on the hard part.
Keep your lower back still and your ribs down. Stop the set if your form breaks.
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: Alternating Lateral Ball Slams is a intermediate core exercise for the abs and chest, performed with an implement.
